newsitem.title: USA: Corning board approves terms for spinoffs.
newsitem.headline: Corning board approves terms for spinoffs.

text.p: Corning Inc. said Wednesday its board of directors approved terms for spinning off two subsidiaries, Corning Clinical Laboratories Inc. and Covance Inc., to shareholders.
Corning Clinical Laboratories conducts clinical laboratory testing for doctors and hospitals, while Covance provides pharmaceutical development services.

Under terms of the spinoffs, Corning shareholders would receive one share of Corning Clinical Laboratories, which will be called Quest Diagnostics, for every eight common shares of Corning they hold on Dec. 31, Corning said.
Shareholders would also receive one share of Covance, formerly known as Corning Pharmaceutical Services, for every four common Corning shares.
The two subsidiaries will become independent, publicly traded companies, Corning said.
Corning is based in Corning, N.Y. Its products include optical fiber, high-performance glass, television components and consumer products.
Corning's stock gained 37.5 cents to $41 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
